summary: Captain, your MBR rebuild is solid: the Reviews entry, collection, and redesigned builder screens all render and match the brief's wording, layout, and flow — start card, Published list, amber draft banner, 'Insights added 16 of 19 KPIs' meter, per-KPI status selects with a distinct off-track X, purple Carried pills, cohort per-source deltas, and month-only locking with no per-bucket affordance. Because this roster is entirely manual, the wired value cells, Refresh-all amber box, and all three dialogs never appear on screen, but your own suite (597 tests, all green) names and settles each of them. Two internal shape-type details (t-004) and one unknown-route fallback (t-002) have no naming test and no visible surface, so I left them honestly untested at low impact; nothing on the list is a gap.
